scan_interval.description: The cycle time (quantum of time) for preload to perform data gathering and predictions. Use an even number.

proactive.description: Whether to use correlation coefficient in the prediction algorithm and proactively predict files.

max_processes.description: Maximum number of processes to use for parallel readahead. Also sets the minimum process size (minsize) for tracking.

mapprefix.description: Semicolon-separated list of path prefixes to accept or reject mapped files. Uses ! prefix to reject.

exeprefix.description: Semicolon-separated list of path prefixes to accept or reject binary executable files.
